HARDWOOD

2026-27 season
Research model, not a sportsbook. Per-game projections with a ~70% range (15th–85th percentile). Lineups/minutes are estimates from last season's minutes + 2026-27 rosters; injured-player minute redistribution is a heuristic adjustment.
